The '''Smoking Jets''' was a bar along [[Spaceport Row]] in [[Plawal Rift]], [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was made out of three prefab white [[plastene]] rooms, made on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], connected into a single long room.
